title: Burst-Resilient Throughput Harness for TP/PP Multi-GPU Inference (sweep & regression pipeline)
creator: Ava Morgan
description: Create an end-to-end load-testing harness that characterizes steady-state tokens/sec and p95 latency under tensor-parallel (TP) + pipeline-parallel (PP) topologies, with a focus on burst resilience (microbursts / slew-rate changes) and automated regression detection. This ticket scopes the bench design, test matrix, gating rules for CI, and alerting thresholds for runtime-1.19. The goal is to produce reproducible, dashboarded benchmarks and a lightweight synthetic load runner that can be used in PR gates and nightly regressions.
acceptance_criteria: Harness reproduces steady-state tokens/sec and p95 for a 8xA100 TP/PP topology across 3 model shapes (7B causal, 34B encoder-decoder, 70B causal).
Microburst scenario generator can inject 10-100x request-rate spikes for short windows (100ms-5s) and report transient tail amplification (p95/p99 ratios).
Automated regression detector (EWMA + seasonal Holt-Winters fallback) raises an alert when tokens/sec drops >8% or p95 increases >25% relative to baseline with 99% confidence.
Artifacts (run logs, raw metrics, condensed CSV, Grafana dashboard link) are published to the project Drive folder and a summary PR posts results in GitHub.
CI job added: nightly benchmark run + fast PR smoke that runs a short version of the harness in staged infra and fails PRs that trigger regression detector.
Run-to-run variance for steady-state tokens/sec is <5% on the controlled lab cluster (same instance types, driver/kernel pinned).
testbed_config: Cluster: 4-node, each node 2xA100 80GB (NVLink enabled), RDMA networking (RoCEv2), Ubuntu 22.04, NVIDIA driver 535.x
TP/PP topologies: (TP=2,PP=2), (TP=4,PP=1), (TP=8,PP=1) depending on model size
Model builds: quantized int8 and fp16 variants; checkpoint pinned to release-candidate/model-v2025-02-10
Workload: mixture of short (8-64 tokens), medium (128-512), and long (1024-4096) sequences reflecting real traffic histogram
KV cache warmup: include cold, warm (single prefix), and hot (repeated prefixes) conditions in matrix
Measurement sinks: Prometheus scrape target + high-fidelity token-level trace collector saved to S3 for postmortem
Synthetic driver: k6 forked to support rate-slew profiles + a custom gRPC token-stream runner for end-to-end path exercise
steps: Finalize workload distribution and seed prompt set (PRD: Drive/Bench/workload-seed-2025-02-12).
Implement microburst generator module and integrate with existing runner (GH: redwood-inference/bench/compare#112).
Wire metrics: tokens/sec (counter), p50/p95/p99 latencies (histogram), queuing length, KV cache hit ratio, kernel busy cycles.
Add regression detector and baseline storage: persist baseline summaries to s3://redwood-bench/baselines/runtime-1.19/.
Run full matrix overnight, capture artifacts, and publish dashboard + condensed report (Drive + Slack channel #infra-bench-results).
Bake a lightweight PR-smoke harness (~5min) with conservative thresholds for pre-merge checks.
results_summary: Initial sweep (2025-02-20) produced stable tokens/sec within 3.7% variance for the 7B fp16 workflow in TP=2,PP=2. However, the 70B int8 PP-heavy run showed transient p95 amplification during 500ms microbursts (p95 rose from 42ms baseline to 180ms at peak), correlated with KV cache misses and a short-lived kernel queue saturation on GPU-0. The regression detector prototype flagged the 70B run consistently; follow-up runs with staged KV warmup reduced p95 spike magnitude by ~60%.
blockers: Intermittent RDMA packet drops observed on node-3 during large microbursts; infra team investigating NIC firmware mismatch. This invalidated two runs and requires a hardware repro and firmware lock before we finalize baselines.
next_steps: Coordinate with infra (jackie.huang) to repro and fix RDMA packet drops; retest after firmware roll or NIC replacement.
Instrument kernel queue counters and add per-GPU scheduling traces to isolate root cause for queue saturation on PP stage 3.
Harden the regression detector by adding a run-to-run variance model and requiring 3 consecutive failing windows before gating a PR.
Add a documentation short guide for engineers to interpret microburst artifacts and recommended mitigations (caching, early reply heuristics, batching windows).
